documents.title: State Process for Informing Consumers of Recalls Program NOFO

rejections.title: State must agree to notify owners/lessees of open recalls at registration
rejections.detail: quote_not_found: The quote does not appear in the cited document.

requirements.title: Eligible applicant must be a State agency with vehicle registration authority
requirements.description: Only a State agency that has the authority to register motor vehicles for use on public roads, and that demonstrates it has the infrastructure, staff, and support to carry out the NOFO activities, is eligible to apply.
evidenceNeeded: Documentation demonstrating infrastructure, staff, and support to administer the program

values: State agency with authority to register motor vehicles

sources.quote: An eligible applicant is a State agency that has the authority to register motor vehicles for use on public roads that demonstrates it has the infrastructure in place, as well as the necessary staff and support, to carry out the responsibilities of administering, coordinating, and implementing the activities of this NOFO

requirements.title: Only one application per eligible applicant
requirements.description: NHTSA will only accept one application from each eligible applicant.

sources.quote: NHTSA will only accept one (1) application from each eligible applicant (see Section II ‘Eligibility’).

requirements.title: Prior award recipients are ineligible
requirements.description: A State that has previously received an award under the State Process for Informing Consumers of Recalls Program is ineligible for an award under this NOFO.
appliesWhen: State previously received an award under this program
Applicant previously received an award under this program

sources.quote: A State that has previously received an award under the State Process for Informing Consumers of Recalls Program is ineligible for an award under this NOFO.

requirements.title: No cost-sharing or matching requirement
requirements.description: Cost-sharing or matching requirements are not required under this NOFO, though applicants are encouraged to seek funds from other sources to augment federal funds.

sources.quote: Cost-sharing or matching requirements are not required under this NOFO.

requirements.title: Anticipated minimum funding request of $300,000
requirements.description: NHTSA anticipates a funding range of $300,000 to $500,000 per award, though it reserves discretion to change these amounts.

sources.quote: The anticipated number of awards is between 3 to 5, with an anticipated funding range of $300,000 to $500,000 each.

requirements.reviewNote: flagged ambiguous by the model: The funding range is described as 'anticipated' and NHTSA reserves the right to change minimum and maximum award sizes, so it is unclear whether this is a firm limit on applicant requests.; mandatory status unclear (guidance wording or ambiguous)

requirements.title: Anticipated maximum funding request of $500,000
requirements.description: NHTSA anticipates a funding range of $300,000 to $500,000 per award, though it reserves discretion to change these amounts.

sources.quote: The anticipated number of awards is between 3 to 5, with an anticipated funding range of $300,000 to $500,000 each.

requirements.reviewNote: flagged ambiguous by the model: The funding range is described as 'anticipated' and NHTSA reserves the right to change minimum and maximum award sizes, so it is unclear whether this is a firm limit on applicant requests.; mandatory status unclear (guidance wording or ambiguous)

requirements.title: Application submission deadline
requirements.description: All applications must be submitted no later than February 4, 2027 to ensure consideration.

sources.quote: Application Deadline: All applications must be submitted no later than February 4, 2027 to ensure consideration.

requirements.title: Must demonstrate capacity to administer the program
requirements.description: The applicant must demonstrate it has the infrastructure, staff, and support to carry out the responsibilities of administering, coordinating, and implementing the activities of this NOFO, based on documentation submitted in the application.
evidenceNeeded: Documentation of infrastructure, staff, and support capacity

sources.quote: Only organizations capable of fulfilling the criteria listed within this NOFO will be considered for an award.

requirements.title: Prohibition on use of funds for lobbying
requirements.description: Funds awarded under the grant program cannot be used for any activity intended to lobby Congress or a State legislative body.
evidenceNeeded: Certification of compliance with lobbying restrictions

sources.quote: Funds awarded under the State Process for Informing Consumers of Recalls Grant Program cannot be used for any activity intended to or designed to lobby Congress or a State legislative body, or to urge a U.S., State, or local legislator to favor or oppose the adoption of any specific legislative proposal pending before any State or local legislative body.

requirements.title: Buy America requirement
requirements.description: Funds awarded are subject to Buy America requirements, prohibiting use of funds to purchase steel, iron, and manufactured products unless produced in the United States.

sources.quote: Funds awarded under the State Process for Informing Consumers of Recalls Grant Program are subject to 23 U.S.C. § 313, Buy America, which prohibits the use of the Government’s funds to purchase steel, iron, and manufactured products, unless they are produced in the United States.

requirements.title: Applications must include performance metrics
requirements.description: Applications must include performance metrics to substantiate project efforts, using science-based evaluation designs appropriate to the project.
evidenceNeeded: Performance metrics and evaluation methodology description

sources.quote: Applications must include performance metrics to substantiate project efforts. Performance measures must use science-based evaluation designs that incorporate methodologies that are appropriate to the project and the established performance metrics

requirements.title: Applicants must include method for analyzing recall completion data
requirements.description: Applicants shall include a method for analysis of recall completion data on an ongoing basis to assist in program evaluation.
evidenceNeeded: Description of recall completion data analysis methodology

sources.quote: Applicants shall include a method for analysis of recall completion data on an ongoing basis to assist in program evaluation.

requirements.title: Costs must meet Uniform Administrative Requirements and Cost Principles
requirements.description: All costs shall meet the Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards under 2 C.F.R. Part 200.

sources.quote: All costs shall meet the Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards. See 2 C.F.R. Part 200.

requirements.title: Prohibition on sub-awards with entities using covered technology
requirements.description: Recipient is prohibited from using funds to enter sub-awards or contracts with entities that use covered technology.

sources.quote: Consistent with 2 C.F.R. § 200.216, the Recipient is prohibited from using government funds to enter sub-awards or contracts (or extend or renew sub-awards or contracts) with entities that

requirements.title: One application per applicant
requirements.description: NHTSA will accept only one application per applicant.

sources.quote: NHTSA will accept one (1) application per applicant.

requirements.title: Application must include cover page, narrative, and required submissions
requirements.description: The application must include a cover page, an application narrative, and required submissions/attachments.

sources.quote: The application must include a cover page, an application narrative and required submissions.

requirements.title: No ZIP file attachments accepted
requirements.description: NHTSA cannot receive email messages containing a ZIP attachment; such files will be removed, though other file types like Word, PowerPoint, and PDF can be received.

sources.quote: NHTSA cannot receive email messages containing a ZIP attachment. The file will be removed, as all ZIP files are blocked. Other file types (e.g. Word, PowerPoint, PDF, etc.) can be received.

requirements.title: Cover page content and length
requirements.description: Each application must include a one-page cover page with the applicant's name, NOFO number, and submission date.

sources.quote: Each application shall include a cover page that includes the applicant’s name, NOFO number 693JJ927R000007, and submission date.

requirements.title: Narrative page limit of 10 pages
requirements.description: The application narrative shall not exceed ten pages, not including appendices or other required submissions.

sources.quote: The application shall not exceed ten (10) pages (not including appendices, or other requirements noted in Section IV.A.3 ‘Required Submissions’).

requirements.title: Narrative format requirements
requirements.description: Applications must be in English, prepared using common commercial software, with standard formatting (Times New Roman 12-point font, single spaced, one inch margins).

sources.quote: All applications must be in English be prepared using a common commercial software application (e.g., MS Office) and with standard formatting preferences (e.g. Times New Roman 12-point font, single spaced, one (1) inch margins).

requirements.title: Cost information excluded from project plan
requirements.description: The applicant shall not include cost information in its project plan; all cost information must be in the budget plan.

sources.quote: The applicant shall not include Cost information in its project plan. All cost information shall be contained in the applicant’s budget plan.

requirements.title: Applicant background section required
requirements.description: Narrative must include applicant background covering agency role/authority, infrastructure/capacity, relevant past performance, and key personnel.

sources.quote: Identify the state agency applying for this program, including its organizational structure, statutory authority, and any relevant inter-agency partnerships that support program administration.

requirements.title: Project plan must include work breakdown and timeline
requirements.description: Applicants must include a Work Breakdown Structure and project schedule in a Gantt chart or equivalent format, with key milestones and anticipated timelines.

sources.quote: Include a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and project schedule in a Gantt chart or equivalent format. Identify key milestones, performance targets, and anticipated timelines for completing each activity.

requirements.title: Quality control and risk mitigation plan required
requirements.description: Applicants must describe a plan for monitoring quality and identify potential risks along with mitigation strategies.

sources.quote: Describe a plan for monitoring and ensuring quality throughout the project. Identify potential risks (e.g., delays in data availability, vendor coordination) and strategies to mitigate or address them.

requirements.title: Budget must list federal and non-federal funding amounts and percentages
requirements.description: The budget must list the amount and percent of both total Federal funding requested and any additional non-Federal funds used for the project.

sources.quote: This budget must list the amount and percent of both the total Federal funding requested and any additional non-Federal funds, if any, that will be used to pay for the project.

requirements.title: Detailed cost breakdown by year and category required
requirements.description: Applicant must provide a detailed breakdown of proposed costs and in-kind costs by year, with sub-categories such as labor, materials, travel, and subcontractor costs, and justify each cost.

sources.quote: The Applicant must provide a detailed breakdown of the proposed costs, as well as any in-kind costs, by year. This cost breakdown shall not only identify cost categories but shall also identify specific sub-categories (and associated costs).

requirements.title: Cost data must be provided in Excel format
requirements.description: Cost data must be provided in a current Microsoft supported version of Microsoft Excel, without hidden cells, and be comprehensive and easy to interpret.
evidenceNeeded: Excel budget file without hidden cells

sources.quote: Cost data shall be provided in current Microsoft supported version of Microsoft EXCEL, without hidden cells, and be comprehensive and easy to interpret.

requirements.title: Required SF forms for federal assistance
requirements.description: Application must include SF-424, 424A, and 424B forms, completed and signed.

sources.quote: The application shall include the Standard Forms for federal assistance. These shall include the 424 “Application for Federal Assistance,” 424A “Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs,” and 424B “Assurances for Non-Construction Programs”).

requirements.title: Drug-Free Workplace certified statement required
requirements.description: The applicant must provide a certified statement agreeing to comply with Drug-Free Workplace requirements under 49 CFR Part 32.

sources.quote: The applicant shall provide with its application a certified statement that it agrees to comply with the requirements in 49 CFR Part 32, Governmentwide Requirements for Drug-Free Workplace (Financial Assistance), subpart B.

requirements.title: Lobbying certification and SF-LLL disclosure required
requirements.description: The applicant must provide a certified statement consistent with 49 CFR Part 20 lobbying restrictions, and an SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities form if required.

sources.quote: The applicant shall provide with its application a certified statement consistent with the requirements in Appendix A to 49 CFR Part 20, U.S. Department of Transportation New Restrictions on Lobbying, and a SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities form, if a disclosure is required by Part 20.

requirements.title: Detailed cost breakdown by year
requirements.description: The applicant must provide a detailed breakdown of proposed costs and in-kind costs by year, including cost categories and sub-categories such as labor, direct materials, travel, subcontractor costs, and overhead.
evidenceNeeded: Detailed cost breakdown by year and category

sources.quote: The Applicant must provide a detailed breakdown of the proposed costs, as well as any in-kind costs, by year.

requirements.title: Justification of proposed costs
requirements.description: The applicant must justify each proposed cost by explaining how it was calculated and determined to be fair and reasonable.

sources.quote: The Applicant must also justify each proposed cost by explaining how each cost was calculated and determined to be fair and reasonable.

requirements.title: Standard Forms for federal assistance required
requirements.description: The application shall include the SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance, SF-424A Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs, and SF-424B Assurances for Non-Construction Programs, completed and with certified assurances signed.

sources.quote: The application shall include the Standard Forms for federal assistance. These shall include the 424 "Application for Federal Assistance," 424A "Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs," and 424B "Assurances for Non-Construction Programs").

requirements.title: Drug-Free Workplace certification required
requirements.description: The applicant shall provide with its application a certified statement that it agrees to comply with the requirements in 49 CFR Part 32, Governmentwide Requirements for Drug-Free Workplace.

sources.quote: The applicant shall provide with its application a certified statement that it agrees to comply with the requirements in 49 CFR Part 32, Governmentwide Requirements for Drug-Free Workplace (Financial Assistance), subpart B.

requirements.title: Lobbying certification and disclosure required
requirements.description: The applicant shall provide a certified statement consistent with 49 CFR Part 20 lobbying restrictions and an SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities form if required, and acknowledge in writing that no funds will be used for lobbying activities.

sources.quote: The applicant shall provide with its application a certified statement consistent with the requirements in Appendix A to 49 CFR Part 20, U.S. Department of Transportation New Restrictions on Lobbying, and a SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities form, if a disclosure is required by Part 20.

requirements.title: Optional resumes limited to two pages
requirements.description: The applicant may submit resumes or curricula vitae for key personnel, limited to two pages each.
evidenceNeeded: Resumes or CVs of key personnel, if submitted

sources.quote: The applicant may submit resumes or curricula vitae that highlight qualifications, areas of expertise, and cites work-related experience for key personal and limited to two (2) pages each.

requirements.title: SAM registration required before submitting application
requirements.description: Each applicant must be registered in SAM before submitting its application.
evidenceNeeded: Active SAM registration prior to application submission

sources.quote: Be registered in SAM before submitting its application;

requirements.title: Valid UEI required in application
requirements.description: The applicant must provide a valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) in its application.

sources.quote: Provide a valid UEI in its application; and

requirements.title: Maintain active SAM registration throughout award consideration
requirements.description: The applicant must continue to maintain an active SAM registration with current information at all times during which it has an active Federal award or an application under consideration.
evidenceNeeded: Continued active SAM registration with updated information

sources.quote: Continue to maintain an active SAM registration with current information, including information on a recipient's immediate and highest level owner and subsidiaries, as well as on all predecessors that have been awarded a Federal contract or grant within the last three years, if applicable, at all times during which it has an active Federal award or an application or plan under consideration by a Federal awarding agency.

requirements.title: Electronic submission via Grants.gov required
requirements.description: Applications must be submitted electronically to Grants.gov; applications sent to individual staff email addresses will not be accepted.
evidenceNeeded: Proof of electronic submission via Grants.gov depository

sources.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically to Grants.gov. Only applications received in the designated Grants.gov depository, by the stated deadline, will be considered.

requirements.title: Application due date and time
requirements.description: Applications must be submitted electronically to Grants.gov no later than 5:00 PM Eastern Time on February 4, 2027.

sources.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically to Grants.gov no later than 5:00 PM Eastern Time on the application deadline February 4, 2027.

requirements.title: Demonstrate civil rights compliance plan in application
requirements.description: As a condition of an award, applicants should demonstrate that they have a plan for compliance with civil rights obligations and nondiscrimination laws, including a current Title VI plan, a completed Community Participation Plan, and a plan addressing ADA compliance for legacy infrastructure or facilities.
evidenceNeeded: ADA compliance plan for legacy infrastructure

sources.quote: As a condition of an award, applicants should demonstrate that the recipient has a plan for compliance with civil rights obligations and nondiscrimination laws, including Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and implementing regulations (49 C.F.R. § 21), the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (ADA), and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act, all other civil rights requirements, and accompanying regulations.

requirements.reviewNote: flagged ambiguous by the model: Uses 'should demonstrate' which is ambiguous as to whether this is mandatory for application completeness or merely a condition applied after selection; it is listed under post-award administrative requirements but phrased as a condition of award.; mandatory status unclear (guidance wording or ambiguous)

requirements.title: Processes for Subaward and Executive Compensation Reporting
requirements.description: Each applicant must have the necessary processes and systems in place to comply with federal reporting requirements for subawards and executive compensation information in order to receive funding.
evidenceNeeded: Description of applicant's processes/systems for 2 CFR Part 170 reporting compliance

sources.quote: Each applicant that applies for Federal financial assistance must have the necessary processes and systems in place to comply with the reporting requirements of 2 C.F.R. Part 170 Reporting Subwards and Executive Compensation Information to receive Federal funding

requirements.title: Civil Rights Compliance Plan Demonstration
requirements.description: Applicants should demonstrate a plan for compliance with civil rights obligations and nondiscrimination laws, including a current Title VI plan, a completed Community Participation Plan, and a plan addressing ADA compliance for legacy infrastructure or facilities.
evidenceNeeded: ADA compliance plan for legacy infrastructure

sources.quote: As a condition of an award, applicants should demonstrate that the recipient has a plan for compliance with civil rights obligations and nondiscrimination laws, including Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and implementing regulations (49 C.F.R. § 21), the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (ADA), and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act, all other civil rights requirements, and accompanying regulations.

requirements.reviewNote: flagged ambiguous by the model: Text uses 'should demonstrate' and frames this 'as a condition of an award', making it unclear whether this must be included in the application itself or only satisfied after selection.; mandatory status unclear (guidance wording or ambiguous)

requirements.title: Conflict of Interest Statement Describing Interests
requirements.description: The applicant must include in its application a statement concisely describing all past, present, or planned organizational, financial, contractual, or other interests with an organization regulated by or affected by DOT activities related to the work under this notice, covering the applicant, affiliates, proposed consultants, subcontractors, and key personnel.
evidenceNeeded: Conflict of interest disclosure statement in application

sources.quote: The applicant shall provide a statement in its application which describes in a concise manner all past, present or planned organizational, financial, contractual or other interest(s) with an organization regulated by U.S. DOT, or with an organization whose interests may be affected substantially by Departmental activities, and which is related to the work under this notice.

requirements.title: Explanation of Impartiality Despite Identified Interests
requirements.description: If interests are identified, the applicant must describe in detail why it believes the proposed grant program can be performed in an impartial and objective manner despite those interests.
appliesWhen: Applicant has identified a relevant interest under the conflict of interest disclosure

sources.quote: The applicant shall describe in detail why it believes, in light of the interest(s) identified in (a) above, that performance of the proposed State Process for Informing Consumers of Recalls Grant program. can be accomplished in an impartial and objective manner.

requirements.title: Certification of No Conflict of Interest
requirements.description: If no relevant interest exists, the applicant must submit in its application a statement certifying that to its best knowledge and belief no affiliation exists relevant to possible conflicts of interest.
appliesWhen: Applicant has no relevant interest to disclose

sources.quote: In the absence of any relevant interest identified in (a) above, the applicant shall submit in its application a statement certifying that to its best knowledge and belief no affiliation exists relevant to possible conflicts of interest.

requirements.title: Obtain Subcontractor Conflict of Interest Information
requirements.description: The applicant must obtain the same conflict of interest information from potential subcontractors prior to award of any subcontract under the grant program.

sources.quote: The applicant must obtain the same information from potential subcontractors prior to award of a subcontract under the resultant State Process for Informing Consumers of Recalls Grant program..

requirements.title: Disqualification for Refusal to Disclose Conflicts of Interest
requirements.description: Refusal to provide the required conflict of interest disclosure, certification, or additional requested information may result in disqualification of the applicant for award.

sources.quote: The refusal to provide the disclosure or representation, or any additional information required, may result in disqualification of the applicant for award.
